exposure: antenatal care utilization (number of visits, sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine doses)
cohort: Pregnant women in Ibadan, Nigeria, who were enrolled at or before 20 weeks gestation at their first antenatal visit.
finding: The use of unprescribed and herbal medicines was common among pregnant women in Ibadan, Nigeria, with specific predictors identified, but these uses were not significantly associated with pregnancy outcomes.
